text: ITR-6 is applicable to companies other than those claiming exemption under section 11 of the Income-tax Act.
Provide company details such as PAN, CIN, registered address, and nature of business accurately.
Report income and expenses as per profit and loss account prepared under applicable accounting standards.
Provide balance sheet details including share capital, reserves, liabilities, and assets.
Compute business income after adjustments for depreciation, disallowances, and incentives.
Companies liable to Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) must compute tax as per section 115JB.
Report capital gains arising from transfer of capital assets during the year.
Include income such as interest, dividends, or other taxable receipts.
Claim deductions and incentives as permitted under the Income-tax Act.
Compute tax liability considering normal provisions or MAT, whichever is higher, along with surcharge and cess.
Report tax deducted or collected at source as per certificates and Form 26AS.
Provide details of advance tax and self-assessment tax payments.
Provide details of bank accounts and select one account for refund, if applicable.
Enter statutory audit and tax audit details as applicable.
Ensure MAT computation details are correctly filled if the company is liable under section 115JB.
Verify the return using digital signature to complete the filing process.
The return is invalid unless verified using a valid digital signature within the prescribed time.
